No. The land-change method could not evaluate ASSET-J. The assessment status is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE because of missing coverage: the source data this property needs (Hansen Global Forest Change, JRC GFC2020 and MGAP 2021) had not been prepared, so no observations were made.

This result says nothing about the land itself. It does not establish that tree-cover loss occurred, that none occurred, or any regulatory or compliance finding, such as EUDR status. The claim was tree-cover loss across the whole asset boundary from 2021-01-01 to 2025-12-31, against a 2020-12-31 baseline. It remains unassessed.

To get an answer, the missing source coverage would need to be prepared and the analysis rerun. The tool also reports no area for the asset (area_ha is null). The method is labelled early access (land-change/1).
